text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, you've grown so much in the 
short time since I last saw you...!"

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Keep this up and train diligently! Of 
course, don't forget to get plenty of rest 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proprietress praised our training 
session! She seems to think pretty highly 
of us.
